key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often the bridge checks the private feed repository. The minimum is 60 and the maximum is 900. The default is 120.

key.name: undo-seconds
key.description: How long Done can be undone in the popup and the window. The default is 5. The minimum is 2 and the maximum is 30.

key.name: muted-bots
key.description: Bot ids that do not raise a notification. An empty list means every bot can notify.

key.name: hidden-bots
key.summary: Bots hidden from the popup and the window
key.description: Bot ids left out of the popup and the window. Their items and rows are not shown.
